summary: Iter6 FRONTEND-only validation of TIMEUP referral/custom-room/deposit/win-celebration/admin overhaul on the public URL (mobile viewport 420x860). Verified: (a) registration with full_name+mobile+password lands on /splash->/home; (b) login form works (mobile+password) and admin (9999999999/Admin@123) redirects to /admin; (c) NO sonner/toaster elements in DOM anywhere (App.js does not render Toaster; PlayFixed.js and Rooms.js still import `toast` from sonner but are unused/unrouted dead code); (d) center-popup component functions (title/message/close) and success popups are triggered by admin actions ('Wallet updated', 'Rejected' etc.); (e) Custom Room modal opens from data-testid=open-custom-room with Create/Join tabs, custom-mode-1v1 / custom-mode-multiplayer, custom-target, custom-fee, create-custom-btn, custom-tab-join, join-code-input, join-code-btn all render; (f) Refer & Earn modal from data-testid=open-referral shows referral-code (e.g. 'TU930151'), copy-referral, share-referral, referral-earnings=0 for new user; (g) Admin Panel tabs (overview/config/payments/deposits/users/withdrawals/live/logs) all load; Deposits tab lists 4 seed deposit rows (data-testid=deposit-row); Users search returns rows; adjust-<id> wallet dialog + wallet-add works and shows 'Wallet updated' center popup; forcewin-<id> toggle works and star icon appears; Live tab loads without console errors. (h) Wallet page opens Deposit modal via data-testid=open-deposit with UPI/USDT tabs, proof-upload-input, submit-deposit, and shows a center-popup warning when submitting without a screenshot ('Screenshot required'). Failures observed on my Playwright side: the insufficient-balance popup on /home was not consistently triggered when clicking start-challenge-btn as a new 0-balance user — the /api/games/fixed/start POST was never observed on the wire during the second run despite the click, and header-balance stayed as '…'. This may be an onboarding-guide-overlay / DailyReward-claim overlay z-index race blocking the click; iter5 verified the same flow works. Also nav-logout to /welcome sometimes routes to /login instead. Full details in action_items.

ui_bugs.issue: In a fresh session, clicking start-challenge-btn with 0 balance did NOT always fire /api/games/fixed/start (no request logged) and no center-popup appeared. Suspect the Guide overlay or DailyReward 'Claim' card is intercepting pointer events until fully dismissed — force=True on the button worked but the underlying handler didn't fire. Iter5 verified this flow works, so likely intermittent, but worth confirming.
nav-logout occasionally routes to /login rather than /welcome (public landing). Not blocking but inconsistent with the review spec that says logout should land on /welcome.

After a fresh login header-balance stayed rendered as '…' (initial placeholder) even after /api/wallet returned 200 twice. The Navbar may not be re-reading wallet after login/route-change; a wallet:refresh event dispatch on auth login would fix it.

action_items: Remove dead code: /app/frontend/src/pages/PlayFixed.js and /app/frontend/src/pages/Rooms.js still import `toast` from sonner though neither page is routed. Delete these files (or the sonner import) so future refactors don't reintroduce top-toasts.
Fix Navbar header-balance staying at '…' after login — dispatch 'wallet:refresh' after AuthContext successfully hydrates /auth/me, or make Navbar re-fetch /api/wallet on `user` change.

Ensure Guide overlay + DailyReward card do NOT overlap the primary CTA (start-challenge-btn). Give the Guide overlay pointer-events:none on its dimming layer once past the last step, and/or auto-close Guide when the user taps the CTA.
Verify nav-logout always routes to /welcome (public landing) not /login.
OPTIONAL: server.py now 1730 lines — router split remains overdue from iter3-5 reviews.
OPTIONAL: RoomGame LIVE screen uses swRef.current?.start() 50ms after mount — verify the Stopwatch component's ref exposes .start()/.stop()/.reset() (assumed since same pattern works on GameHome).
OPTIONAL: /rooms/:id polling every 2s in addition to WS is wasteful; keep WS-only with a 15s heartbeat fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: PlayFixed.js and Rooms.js are unused and still import sonner `toast` — remove.

CenterPopup auto-dismiss timer uses window.__pzPopupT (window-scoped) — fine but collides across host instances; if two CenterPopupHost mount (route swap) the timer could clear the wrong popup. Use a ref instead.

WinCelebration.playWinSound builds a new AudioContext on every trigger without close on abort — 1.4s setTimeout cleans it up but if the tab is backgrounded before that fires the AudioContext leaks. Wrap ctx.close in a finally.
Wallet.js openDeposit sets method to 'upi' by default even when a URL param triggered it — fine, but if pay?.upi?.enabled=false the modal shows no tab. Guard by picking the first enabled method.
Admin.js Field component treats empty string as NaN when type=number — parseFloat('')===NaN gets stored; add fallback `|| 0` or leave as `null`.

RoomGame.js celebratedRef.current is set once per mount; if the user leaves and rejoins after COMPLETED it will re-celebrate. Acceptable but add a localStorage guard by room_id if you want it truly once.
GameHome.js loss-replay uses same bet/target and calls startWith — server may reject with 'session in progress' if the previous session isn't finalised; observed clean in iter5 so acceptable.
Guide.js overlay: verify pointer-events on the outer dim div so the underlying CTA isn't dead-clicked after final step (see UI bug above).
No global 401-handler in api.js observed — a stale token results in silent 401s. Add an axios interceptor that dispatches logout on 401.

Referral + Custom Room modals both wired correctly. sonner Toaster is NOT rendered anywhere — spec compliant. If retesting insufficient popup, first dismiss Guide fully (iterate guide-next until removed AND wait for DailyReward Claim not to overlap the button), or scroll to and click via elementFromPoint. New test user for retest: 9788537730 (has 500 coins + force_win); alternatively register another 10-digit mobile.
rca of the issue: The Playwright-side failure on the insufficient-balance flow appears to be an overlay pointer-events race between the Guide onboarding component + DailyReward Claim card and the start-challenge-btn CTA. Even with force=True the wire request never fired, which indicates React's onClick handler is bound to a covered element, not that force=True missed the target. Root fix on app side: after last Guide step, ensure both the overlay dim and the tooltip get `pointer-events:none` OR unmount entirely; then confirm the DailyReward card sits *below* the CTA in DOM stacking. On my side: iter5 got past this by clicking guide-next specifically before interacting; the newer flow in iter6 uses a slightly different guide (with X close). The nav-logout->/login vs /welcome issue is likely because AuthContext.logout redirects to /login but RootRedirect only sends unauthenticated users to /login (not /welcome). Update logout to `nav('/welcome')` explicitly if the spec says landing.
